paper_title: Direct Searches for Hidden-Photon Dark Matter with the SHUKET Experiment
notes: SHUKET dish-antenna hidden-photon search, 5-6.8 GHz (20.8-28.3 ueV). Paper states chi < ~5e-12 at 95% CL across the wide band (encoded as flat two-point line); exact frequency-dependent limit only in Fig. 5 (not tabulated). Third point is the narrow-band 22.2 h run at 6.331525 GHz (power limit 2.1e-21 W vs ~1e-18 W average), converted via chi ~ sqrt(P) scaling of Eq. 2, giving chi ~ 2.3e-13 at m = 2.62e-5 eV. Assumes HP constitute all local DM with rho = 0.3 GeV/cm^3. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.75, 3))
